findings.root_cause: The revision inserted two tasks (4a, 8b) but updated the release-unit count by only one; a stale number feeds the gate's release-unit check.

findings.evidence: Revised Task 1 maps the three Run-fault codes to 'durable FAILED + `host.run_fault` 事件' (plan.md:168) and Task 1 verification asserts 'durable FAILED + 稳定码' (plan.md:171). The S4 recorder rejects any event kind outside {host.turn, host.file, host.test} (backend/deskpet/task_scope/store.py:185; convenience wrappers :657-663), and the frozen material/trivial mapping table in the plan (plan.md:81) has no `host.run_fault` entry, while Task 2 requires mapping-table exhaustiveness (plan.md:178) and AC-1① requires every event kind to map deterministically. As written, emitting `host.run_fault` either fails at the recorder or leaves an unclassified kind. Fix (definite): either (a) extend the recorder allowlist + mapping table (`host.run_fault` = trivial) in Task 1/2 and the Task 0 design freeze, or (b) record the fault only as the foreground run's durable FAILED observation (foreground_runs) without a task_scope event, and drop the event from Task 1.
findings.root_cause: The revision introduced a new Host objective-event kind without adding it to the S4 recorder allowlist or the frozen dirty-flag mapping table.

findings.evidence: Task 4a (dependency: Task 0 only; '可与 Task 1–3 分兵，Memory 仓', plan.md:192; execution mode plan.md:234 claims file sets are disjoint) also changes Host files: `human_memory_v7.py` passes `supported_filter_policies`/evidence authority/first-build registration and deletes the fail-open branch, and bumps the Host pin (plan.md:189). But the Host evidence-authority module `backend/deskpet/memory/evidence_authority.py` is created in Task 4 (plan.md:195), which depends on 4a (plan.md:200) — a cycle in the Host wiring; and the Host pin bump changes the shared backend `.venv` wheel under Task 1–3 while they are still validated on 0.6.0. Fix: keep Task 4a Memory-repo-only (0.6.1 code, tests, wheel, manifest) and move the Host-side items (pin bump, supported_filter_policies, evidence authority wiring, register_principal_owner call, fail-open deletion + first-conversation regression) to the head of Task 4; alternatively create `evidence_authority.py` in Task 4a and state the venv switch point explicitly.
findings.root_cause: Splitting the 0.6.1 core into Task 4a left Host-side wiring in the Memory-repo task while its Host dependency was placed in the later Task 4.

findings.evidence: CURRENT S5B-AC-1① reads 'Harness Provider/Tool/Context/Route 证据由 Host 侧 source-ledger outbox 按 source_event_id+payload_hash 幂等导入并推进 task_scope_run_watermarks'. The revised plan deletes the outbox/worker (plan.md:84, 153) and replaces it with same-transaction ingest plus `harness_evidence_reservations` (plan.md:118, 124, 177). All verifiable properties of the clause are preserved (source_event_id+payload_hash idempotency via `ExecutionEvidenceIngress.ingest`, watermark advance, four Harness kinds, run_terminal last), so this is a mechanism-noun drift rather than a semantic violation, but none of A1–A12 covers the wording. Fix: add an amendment (A13) rewording 'source-ledger outbox' to 'source-ledger reservation + same-transaction ingest', or record the interpretation in the Task 0 verification-spec oracle notes so the gate does not read the plan as diverging from acceptance.
findings.root_cause: The revision changed the Harness-evidence import mechanism named in the acceptance text without proposing the corresponding acceptance amendment.

findings.evidence: plan.md:52 (investigation item 7, untouched by the revision) still states '本增量兑现前三条' for the fault-matrix lanes, while the revised file table (plan.md:141) and Task 0 (plan.md:161) commit to four lanes including `taskscope-init-binding`. The contradiction that finding `fault-runners-built-after-they-are-needed` named ('lane 数量在 plan 内自相矛盾') therefore survives in the narrative section. Fix: change plan.md:52 to '本增量兑现四条'.
